CGI is an IT and business consulting services firm seeking an Entry Level Software Developer. The role designs, builds, tests, and enhances client-focused technology solutions while collaborating with cross-functional Agile teams. Responsibilities include software development, API and database integration, debugging, documentation, and the responsible use of AI-assisted development tools.

Responsibilities
Develop and maintain software features using modern programming languages and frameworks, contributing to front-end, back-end, or full stack solutions
Work as part of an Agile team to design, code, test, and deliver applications, learning CGI’s engineering practices and collaborating closely with peers
Apply emerging technologies - such as generative AI, cloud platforms, automation tools, or DevOps practices - based on project needs and team direction
Build and integrate APIs, data connections, and service components that enable secure and reliable system interoperability
Support debugging, troubleshooting, and performance improvements across application and system components
Work with databases, data models, and queries to support application functionality and basic analytics or reporting needs
Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate coding, documentation, and testing, validating outputs through reviews and best practices
Document code, designs, and processes to support maintainability, clarity, and future enhancements
Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into practical, scalable software solutions

Required

with software development in languages such as Java, C#, .NET, Python, C++, or JavaScript, with a solid understanding of object-oriented programming
Foundational experience with frontend frameworks such as React, Angular
Working knowledge of SQL and basic familiarity with REST APIs and integration concepts
Ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and technologies quickly
Strong analytical thinking paired with clear written and verbal communication skills
Adaptability, curiosity, and comfort working in collaborative, team-oriented environments
Understanding of SDLC fundamentals, including basic testing practices and application development principles
Familiarity with cloud concepts or hybrid/multi-cloud environments (coursework or projects welcome)
Ability to work in the U.S. permanently and without restriction
Benefits
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life.
We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being.
You’ll have opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
Accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
